taskScheduler.title: Task scheduler
taskScheduler.description: This area is reserved for operating and inspecting <0>background work</0> (queues, retries, schedules) that today run in the stack via <1>Celery</1> and <2>Redis</2> (<3>back-workers</3>). Nothing here talks to the workers yet; the admin UI is a shell until an API exists.

future.title: What it will be for
future.item1: See scheduled and ad-hoc jobs (name, cron or trigger, last run, failures)
future.item2: Pause or retry from the console when we expose safe controls
future.item3: Align with long-running tasks: email, exports, cleanup — not interactive product CRUD

today.title: What works today
today.description: Workers and Redis are part of the docker stack; job code lives under <0>back-workers/</0>. There is <1>no</1> admin API to list or edit schedules from this screen yet.

taskScheduler.notice: <0>Create / edit jobs</0> — The old placeholder form has been removed. When this ships, creation will go through a real backend contract (validation, auth, audit), not a dummy POST.
